source.custodian: Department of Land Records and Surveys (DLRS), Bangladesh; public Settlement map application
source.localRegistryEvidence: The official viewer accepted Rajbari district hierarchy and returned a BDS survey and Rajbari Sadar mouza record. This is local/district map evidence, not merely national agency prose.

attempts.outcome: 411 on an empty POST body; retried with Content-Length: 0 and received divisions.
Returned Rajbari Sadar upazila and one listed map unit.
Returned 99,429-byte GeoJSON FeatureCollection with 183 polygons and EPSG:4326 CRS.
Returned metadata with bbox and Dag labels; bbox does not contain the WUP point.

schema.identityDecision: Dag_No is the only retained candidate native parcel identity; FID and Id were treated as implementation/row fields. No sample GeoJSON was retained because the bounded extent misses the immutable city point.

scopeLimits: The response covers one listed Rajbari Sadar mouza (Maitkora), not the entire Rajbari urban area.
An extent miss is not citywide absence; no exact-point negative was asserted.
No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe owner data, or TLS exception was used.
uncertainty: The public map hierarchy may expose only currently digitized/selected survey coverage.
The exact relationship between the WUP city point and the returned Rajbari Sadar map unit was not established from the bounded anonymous responses.
Runtime integration remains held until a serial reviewer independently qualifies adapter behavior and coverage.
